title.narrative: Preserving and Advancing Universal Access to UNESCO Archives Digitized Films

description.narrative:
UNESCO’s fragile audiovisual heritage, including nitrate films and early video formats, is at imminent risk of irreversible loss. This one-year initiative aims to digitize and safeguard a curated selection of these materials. During the selection, UNESCO will have special attention to items of historical and cultural relevance to Japan.
Outcome: Through this project, UNESCO will preserve, digitize, preserve, and make accessible a vital segment of its endangered audiovisual archives, contributing to global knowledge and intercultural dialogue. The digitized collections will be made available to researchers, educators, and the public via UNESCO’s digital platforms, reinforcing the Organization’s commitment to universal access to information. In addition, the project will support the production of a short curated archival video highlighting Japan’s contribution to UNESCO over the past 75 years, to be used at the commemorative event marking the 75th anniversary of Japan’s membership in UNESCO, scheduled for June.
